metadata.title: UNSEEN Food & Travel Series of Siliguri + Darjeeling + Kalimpong & Kurseong with Anubhav Sapra I DFW
metadata.description:
North Bengal is a place of unending natural beauty and hence it is one of the favourite travel destination. It is blessed with mountains, forests, rivers and sprawling tea gardens. Just like its outstanding pristine beauty, it also boasts of unique foodscape that is influenced by different cultures. In the coming few weeks we will be taking you on a thrilling food journey across this part of Bengal. The North Bengal Food Series covers a fascination gastronomic expedition spanning across the cities of Siliguri, Kalimpong, Darjeeling and Kurseong. Tune in to the trailer for a sneak peek into this memorable trip.


About the host - Anubhav Sapra
https://anubhavsapra.com/

Anubhav Sapra is an avid culinary explorer who loves to travel and explore different cuisines primarily the street food, not just for the sake of gustatory pleasure but also for quenching his deep thirst for nurturing new cultural connections through the kaleidoscopic canvas of food. He believes that the vibrant and delectable street food tradition across the globe has the power to bring communities together and foster harmonious human existence.

For more such fascinating culinary explorations and stories do subscribe to our channel and follow us on our social media handles.


Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/delhifoodwalks
Twitter: https://twitter.com/delhifoodwalks
Instagram: https://instagram.com/delhifoodwalks

 
Design and filmed by Rahul Singh 
https://www.instagram.com/iamrahulsingh.2/
